# MS-B660M GAMING WIFI ICE

- Model
- MS-B660M GAMING WIFI ICE

- CPU Support
- Supports LGA1700 socket Intel 12th/13th/14th Gen processors

- Motherboard Type
- M-ATX

- Memory
- 2 x DIMM DDR4 slots supporting 2133-3200MHz Supports Intel® XMP

- Power Delivery
- 4+1+1 phase, 50A Dr.MOS

- Display Ports
- VGA + HDMI

- Network
- Integrated Realtek 8111H network chip (10/100/1000Mbps) 1 x onboard RJ45 port 1 x onboard Realtek 8821CE wireless network card, supports Bluetooth

- Storage
- 1 x M.2 slot (supports 2242/2280 PCIe X4/X2 SSD) 3 x SATA 3.0 ports

- USB Ports
- Rear Ports: 2 x USB 3.2 GEN1, 4 x USB 2.0 Internal Headers: 1 set (2 ports) USB 2.0 headers, 1 set (2 ports) USB 3.2 GEN1 headers

- Expansion Slots
- 1 x PCIEX16 4.0 slot 1 x PCIEX1 3.0 slot

- RGB Features
- 1 x 12V RGB header 2 x 5V ARGB headers Supports Maxsun Sync lighting control
